summary.text: Black lanterns are a light phenomenon unique to immemorial black heaven, countless blooming flames whose blind fire blinds those who do not shut their eyes in time.

claims.text: While Central Continent’s three Immortal Gu Houses stop to rest after a night heavenly wolf group withdraws, countless lights bloom around them like light red flowers with dark spots hidden inside the flames; Bi Chen Tian names the phenomenon black lanterns, says blind fire is nurtured inside them, and shouts at the Gu Immortals not to look. Many Gu Immortals look before they can react, and by the time the three Immortal Gu Houses escape, at least three Gu Immortals are permanently blind and seven more have severely weakened vision that can only be salvaged at a high price. Black lanterns cause no physical damage of their own, so the Immortal Gu Houses simply fly on through them rather than around.

Black lanterns are a type of phenomenon unique to black heaven, like wind, rain, or lightning, and rank eight Gu Immortals exploring that heaven normally avoid them from afar on sight; this time the Central Continent Gu Immortals had just escaped the night heavenly wolf group and did not expect them to appear with the three Immortal Gu Houses right at their center. Among those blinded is the rank seven Gu Immortal Shi Ge, who loses his sight permanently.

Later, while the expedition rests on a field of heaven attached fungi, Zhao Lian Yun sees new lights in the distance; they are not the blind fire from black lanterns because the color is different, and they turn out to be a star cloud storm.
Long after this journey, Fang Yuan collates black lantern blind fire among a haul of other named flames such as date flame, phoenix song flame, and elephant tusk flame.
